ev.q: Publicly supported family planning services prevent an estimated 1.3 million unintended pregnancies annually (5).
This report reviews the history of family planning during the past century

methods_quotes.q: Perfect use is a best guess of the probabilities of method failure (pregnancy) during the first year of perfect use
For spermicides, periodic abstinence, the diaphragm, male condom, and pill, these estimates for typical use were derived from the experiences of married women
The estimates for the intrauterine device, sterilization, Depo-Provera®, and Norplant® were from large clinical investigations.
